Table.Name: Command
Table.Command: select T0.U_NS_BL, T0.DocNum, T0.CardName, T0.U_NS_Guia, T2.Phone1, T2.Phone2, T2.Cellular, T2.City, T0.Address, T1.SlpName, T1.U_Telefono, U_NS_BultosEntrega, U_NS_BultosGuia, T4.Name, T3.Name, T0.U_NS_PesoTotEntrega FROM OINV T0 INNER JOIN OSLP T1 ON T0.SlpCode = T1.SlpCode inner join OCRD T2 ON T0.CardCode = T2.CardCode left join [@NS_PERSONALLOGIST] T3 ON T0.U_NS_EntregadoPor=T3.Code left join [@NS_PLACA] T4 on T0.U_NS_Placa=T4.Code WHERE U_NS_BL like '{?Ruta}'
